title: A Speech Corpus for Mizo Automatic Speech Recognition: Whisper and SraVaani 1.0 Fine-Tuning with Morphology-Aware Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19361v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study reports the development of an Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) system in Mizo, a low-resource language. The development included collecting 17.62 hours of speech data, curating it, and fine-tuning the Mizo ASR system with three Whisper multilingual models and with the SraVaani 1.0 Indic multilingual model. Whisper-large-v3 achieved the lowest conventional WER (18.08%), while morphology-aware evaluation yielded a WER of 7.22%. Zero-shot evaluation of the SraVaani 1.0 Indic multilingual model yielded a WER of 58.27%, while Mizo-specific fine-tuning reduced the conventional WER to 29.45% and the morphology-aware WER to 17.93%. The results demonstrate that the Whisper model can achieve a substantially low WER, even when adapted to an unseen language. In contrast, SraVaani 1.0 supports the Mizo language in its multilingual model; however, fine-tuning with carefully curated Mizo speech data substantially improves its performance.

translated_title: 米佐语自动语音识别语音语料库：Whisper与SraVaani 1.0的微调及形态学感知评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19361v1 公告类型：新 摘要：本研究报道了在低资源语言米佐语中开发自动语音识别（ASR）系统的过程。开发工作包括收集17.62小时的语音数据、进行数据整理，并使用三个Whisper多语言模型和SraVaani 1.0印度多语言模型对米佐语ASR系统进行微调。Whisper-large-v3实现了最低的传统词错误率（WER）18.08%，而形态学感知评估的WER为7.22%。SraVaani 1.0印度多语言模型的零样本评估WER为58.27%，而针对米佐语的微调将传统WER降至29.45%，形态学感知WER降至17.93%。结果表明，Whisper模型即使适应于未见过的语言也能实现显著低的WER。相比之下，SraVaani 1.0在其多语言模型中支持米佐语；然而，使用精心整理的米佐语语音数据进行微调可大幅提升其性能。
tldr: 本研究通过收集和整理米佐语语音数据，微调Whisper和SraVaani 1.0模型，实现了低资源语言米佐语的自动语音识别，其中Whisper-large-v3达到最低传统WER 18.08%，且形态学感知评估显示更优性能。
en_tdlr: This study develops a Mizo ASR system by collecting and curating speech data, fine-tuning Whisper and SraVaani 1.0 models, achieving a low conventional WER of 18.08% with Whisper-large-v3 and improved performance via morphology-aware evaluation.
